presets.description: Chat Pile 'Shrine' (David Fitt, 2026-09-04, album 'Who Loves the Sun'): long-lens environmental scenes, hard cuts on impact, single over-exposed flash cut for the build. presets.name: Dogma Paint Stroke Dissolve
presets.description: Kim Ximya 'Dogma' (Park Chan-kyong, 2026-09-04 surprise 26-min single): crossfades end-to-end with paint-stroke masks and layered spatial zooms. Reads as moving painting, audio-reactive dissolves NOT cuts. Resolve 20 / Fusion paint-stroke mask node analog — heavy blur, liquid warp, painterly grain.

presets.name: Pause Freeze Frame
presets.description: Pause Freeze Frame: zeros motion and audio reactivity so the render loop ticks but produces the same frame every time. Use as a 'still photo' mode — captures the current composition at rest, no beat-sync pulses, no pans, no scale. Pair with the engine's #play toggle to also silence audio. Apply a different preset to resume motion.
